lines.en: I run across the grass, leaving scorch marks.

lines.zh: 我小步跳着，火星往后撒。
lines.en: I hop along, sparks trailing behind.

lines.zh: 我绕着那块岩石走了三圈。
lines.en: Three laps around that boulder.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩下去是热的。
lines.en: My hooves land warm.
I hurry, and so does my fire.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面跑，像一片火。
lines.en: I skim the ground like a patch of fire.
I light up the night wood.

lines.zh: 我穿过草丛，草尖卷起来。
lines.en: I pass and the grass tips curl.
I walk and glance back at you.
Fire dances on my back and does not go out.
My steps are light. My fire is loud.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的足迹，会烫脚。
lines.en: Step in my prints and they burn.
I circle you without closing in.
I reach the river and stop.
I leave embers all the way.
I run best at night.
Standing, my flame sways slowly.
I burn without fuel.

lines.zh: 我坐下来，地上的草焦了。
lines.en: I sit; the grass beneath chars.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我身上的火偏一边。
lines.en: Wind pushes my fire sideways.

lines.zh: 我安静的时候，火也安静。
lines.en: When I am quiet, so is the fire.
I wait for the other ember.
Rain does not kill me. I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔蹄子，火星四散。
lines.en: I lick a hoof; sparks scatter.
My eyes outshine the fire.

lines.zh: 这处草地让我烫出个圈。
lines.en: I have burned a ring in this meadow.
I listen to the night insects.

lines.zh: 余烬落在我脚边，自己烧着。
lines.en: Embers fall and burn by themselves.
I do not sleep, and neither does the fire.
I count my own falling sparks.
I remember every field I've burned.
Stand long enough and ash gathers.
You smell of kindling.
Not too close. It burns.
Lighting a fire, or watching mine?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在夜里很显眼吧。
lines.en: My eyes stand out at night.
You do not fear fire. Curious.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里那支火把。
lines.en: I know that torch in your hand.

lines.zh: 你身后有一团余烬跟着。
lines.en: Another ember trails behind you.

lines.zh: 我不烧活的东西，除非它挡路。
lines.en: I do not burn the living, unless blocked.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的光照得很长。
lines.en: My light stretches your shadow.
If I run, you cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，真的会烫。
lines.en: Do not reach out. It truly burns.
Here I am. A walking fire.
My flame drops a notch.

lines.zh: 我掉了几点余烬在草上。
lines.en: A few embers of me dropped on the grass.
I withdraw; the flame shivers.
For a moment, I dim.
A few embers fall off me.
It hurts, so I run faster.
I stamp out a patch of my own fire.
Do not think fire fears you.
Still burning. Just smaller.
I circle off and gather flame.
Wood? I never eat that.

lines.zh: 你举着煤炭，我倒有兴趣。
lines.en: Coal? Now that interests me.
Too damp. It will not catch.
I accept the fuel you offer.

lines.zh: 我不需要喂，我自己会烧。
lines.en: I need no feeding. I burn on my own.
Set the coal down and step back twice.
Good charcoal. Very dry.
I smell sulfur.
Your food would scorch near me.
I prefer to find my own fuel.
What you hold is too cold.
Do not toss it. You will get burned.

lines.zh: 这点火不够我烧一晚上。
lines.en: That will not last me a night.
Stack the coal and I will come.
I do not eat, but I like fuel.

lines.zh: 你给的东西，我碰一下就行。
lines.en: One touch is enough.
Hit me and your sleeve singes.
I stepped aside so you would not burn.
Stay back. My fire leaps.
You jump back from the heat.
I only caught your boot's edge.
Sparks hit the ground and die.

lines.zh: 我撞你的时候，火苗往前扑。
lines.en: When I bump you, the flame lunges.
My hooves are careless; so is my fire.
You back off; the grass still burns.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，你的手有焦味。
lines.en: After the bump, your hand smells burnt.
Where is the other ember?
We come in pairs.

lines.zh: 火与灵魂之火，离得不远。
lines.en: Fire and soul fire stay near.
Stop asking. The heat reaches faces.
Alone, I burn just fine.
Ask at night.

lines.zh: 我的同伴在更冷的地方。
lines.en: My counterpart is where it is colder.

lines.zh: 两团火靠近，会烧成一团。
lines.en: Two fires near become one.
I burned that sentence.
You should back off. Too hot.

lines.zh: 这块煤，我用蹄子拨过来。
lines.en: I nudge the coal over with a hoof.

lines.zh: 地上的木片，被我点着了。
lines.en: The wood chips catch as I pass.
I burned the head off your arrow.
I pick it up and it heats at once.

lines.zh: 这块东西，我留着当燃料。
lines.en: I will keep this as fuel.

lines.zh: 烫的东西我拿着不费劲。
lines.en: Hot things are easy for me to carry.

lines.zh: 你掉的火把，我重新点着了。
lines.en: I relit the torch you dropped.
I scatter the ash on the ground.
I carry it to the stone's edge.
Do not touch it. I just held it.
My fire stands upright.
I see you. I do not back off.
I charge. Quickly.

lines.zh: 草在我脚下烧开一条路。
lines.en: The grass burns a path for me.

lines.zh: 草往那边倒，我就知道了。
lines.en: The grass bends that way—I know.

lines.zh: 我的角尖，对着你的影子。
lines.en: My horn points at your shadow.

lines.zh: 火越烧越亮，说明我来了。
lines.en: My fire brightens as I come.
You carry things that burn.
I do not plan to stop.
You backed to the water. Good.
I circle you; the ring of fire tightens.
You stepped on scorched soil.

lines.zh: 我跑来跑去，不给你机会。
lines.en: I dart about. No openings.

lines.zh: 我的火星落满了这片地。
lines.en: Sparks cover this ground.
Backing to the river. Wise.
I run faster and the flame rises.
You turn and I am over there.
I count what escape you have left.

lines.zh: 草烧起来，烟会遮你眼睛。
lines.en: The grass burns; smoke blinds you.
Not yet. Two more laps first.
Even this little flame of mine burns.

lines.zh: 火跟着我的角一起过来。
lines.en: The fire comes with my horns.
I pass, and your cuff singes.
Sparks ride my hooves.
I hit and run, then circle back.
The grass burns at your feet.
My hoof catches your knee.
Your sleeve caught. Put it out.
Light blow. The heat is the problem.
I withdraw; the fire stays.
A red spark lights in the grass.
One more fire in the night.
I walk out over the embers.

lines.zh: 这片林子开始暖起来了。
lines.en: The wood grows warm.
Sparks arrive first, then me.

lines.zh: 一堆枯叶自己烧起来了。
lines.en: A pile of leaves catches on its own.
I rise from the scorched earth.
A little ember lands on the grass.
My fire looks fine at night.
Something nearby is burning.

lines.zh: 火对火，我一点感觉都没有。
lines.en: Fire against fire. I feel nothing.
I fall into a pit; sparks fly.

lines.zh: 水一浇，我的火只剩一缕。
lines.en: Water hits and my fire thins to a wisp.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我的火吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters my flame.
Sparks leak from the arrow hole.
Magic smothers my fire. Cold.
No fuel, and I fade.

lines.zh: 雷击让我的火暴涨又收。
lines.en: Lightning surges my fire, then drops it.

lines.zh: 我和另一簇余烬，成对走。
lines.en: Another ember walks with me, always in pairs.
